snippet.title: "DRAPLINE" Early Access Announcement for Steam
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3103780/
From Kanawo, the creator of "Noel the Mortal Fate"—a brand-new training roguelite! "DRAPLINE" launches in Early Access on Steam® on Monday, June 30, 2025!

■Early Access Launch: June 30, 2025 (Mon), 4:00 PM JST (Subject to slight changes)
■Genre: Training Roguelite – Raise the Strongest Dragon Girl
■Languages Supported: Japanese / English / Simplified Chinese
■Price: ¥1200 (during Early Access period) Note: The price will be revised for the full release.

■ABOUT THIS GAME
A disaster looms over the world...
You've found a hungry little dragon—raise her into the strongest dragon girl your way!
Each game session lasts about 1 hour, packed with randomized events and strategic choices.
Enjoy a fresh journey every run in this uniquely structured roguelite.

■Key Features in Early Access
① Play the full main scenario: “DAYS OF TORNADO”! Experience the story from beginning to end.
② New High-Difficulty Mode! For expert players who love tough builds and tactical planning.
(While the main story is beginner-friendly, post-game content ramps up the difficulty!)
③ Revamped UI! Improved interfaces for smoother, more immersive gameplay.
④ 150+ Skills to Discover! Including risky high-power skills that boost strategy and build freedom.

New boss enemies and pixel art assets have also been added far beyond the demo version.
We welcome your feedback and reviews to help shape the future of "DRAPLINE"!

----------------------------
■PROFILE
▼KANAWO
An indie developer creating games solo. Known for the hit title "Noel the Mortal Fate", which was ported to Nintendo Switch™, PlayStation®4, and Xbox in 2022 (Steam release: May 2018).
Author on X ▶ /kanawo_tu0

©KANAWO / Vaka, Inc.

#roguelite
#RaisingSimulation
